title: ObjectFFRFreducedOrder: an efficient ODE2 Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectFFRFreducedOrder declares ODE2_ODE2 and ODE2_ODE2_t without a function, so CSystem differentiates it numerically and serially, although the reduced stiffness and damping matrices are constant and the quadratic velocity terms are closed forms. Decided: an analytic or automatic Jacobian, measured on perfObjectFFRFreducedOrder first.
